name: Philadelphia First-Time Homebuyer Grant
summary: Up to $10,000 for eligible first-time buyers purchasing within Philadelphia city limits. Income and home price limits apply.
notes: Requires homeownership counseling; minimum borrower contribution may apply.

name: Keystone Home Loan (PHFA)
summary: Fixed-rate mortgages for eligible buyers; can be paired with down-payment assistance.
notes: Income and purchase price limits vary by county; counseling may be required.

name: NJHMFA Down Payment Assistance Program
summary: Interest-free, forgivable DPA loan up to a set amount for qualified buyers.
notes: Must use an NJHMFA participating lender; income and location limits apply.

name: Homeward Bound Mortgage
summary: Affordable 30-year fixed-rate mortgage for first-time buyers; options for DPA.
notes: Eligibility varies; check credit and income thresholds.
